onboarding.welcomeBody: This short tour shows you, in three steps, how to organise your finances and where to start.
onboarding.categoriesBody: Transactions are grouped by category. You can rename, recolour and adjust the 7 suggested categories from the settings page.
onboarding.firstTransactionBody: From the "Add" button, save an income or an expense: your dashboard updates instantly.
onboarding.doneBody: Check your statistics as soon as you have a second transaction, and come back here whenever you want.
onboarding.firstRunDescription: Add your first transaction to see your totals, charts and monthly budget come to life.

home.title: Your finances, simply clear
home.subtitle: Finance App brings your income, your expenses and your statistics together in one place, in French and English, in the currency you choose.
home.featuresSubtitle: An app built to track a straightforward budget, without spreadsheets or headaches.
home.feature1Body: Balance, income and expenses for the month at a glance, with the change compared to the previous month.
home.feature2Body: Seven ready-to-use categories that you can rename and recolour to your liking.
home.feature3Body: Six months of trends, your spending breakdown by category and your cumulative balance.
home.feature4Body: Switch months in one click to find exactly what you spent or earned.
home.feature5Body: Every label is available in French and English, and your choice is remembered.
home.feature6Body: Transactions are entered in the currency you choose and converted everywhere: dashboard, statistics and lists all show the same amount.
home.stepsSubtitle: Three steps, and your tracking starts.
home.step1Body: An email address and a password are all it takes. No phone number required.
home.step2Body: One income, one expense, one category: the dashboard updates instantly.
home.step3Body: Over time your habits become visible and your decisions rest on real numbers.
home.ctaTitle: Ready to take control of your finances?
home.ctaBody: Create your account in under two minutes, free and with no commitment.
